title: An Optimal Regularity Theory for Immersed Stable Minimal Hypersurfaces with Small Singular Set
summary: We show that if $M^n$ is a properly immersed, two-sided, stable minimal hypersurface in $B^{n+1}_1(0)\setminus S$, where $S$ is closed with $\mathcal{H}^{n-2}(S)=0$, then $\text{dim}_{\mathcal{H}}\text{sing}(M)\leq n-7$, namely $\overline{M}\cap B^{n+1}_1(0)$ is represented by a smooth minimal immersion outside a closed set of generally unavoidable singularities which has Hausdorff dimension at most $n-7$.
